description: The boolean literal B"..." and its hexadecimal form BX"..." (ISO §2023:8.3.3.4: "Boolean literals are of the class and category boolean", 8.3.3.4.1). A COBOL-2002 introduction, QUOTED: ANSI X3.23-1985 says "Every literal belongs to one of two types, nonnumeric or numeric" (§1985:IV.4.2.2.2). Gated position-blind on the TOKEN by LiteralScreen.GateFormat (kb/Work PB5416), because a literal stands in positions that seed no item. Its own row, apart from boolean-data-2002, so the edition diagnostic names the literal and not the PICTURE 1 / USAGE BIT data the program may not use (kb/Work PB5535).
citation: ISO §2023:8.3.3.4 (Boolean literals); §2023:8.3.3.4.1; §1985:IV.4.2.2.2 (a COBOL-85 literal is nonnumeric or numeric)
vcr: M2 catalog national/boolean; the literal leg of boolean-data-2002 (kb/Work PB5535)
